 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sculpter"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Sculptor"**. (मूर्तिकार)

 
 
• **Meaning:** A person who creates sculptures as an art form. (मूर्तियां बनाने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
• **Example:** The sculptor created a magnificent statue of the goddess.
 
 
 
• The correct word, **"Sculptor"**, refers to a professional artist who carves, molds, or shapes materials like stone, wood, or metal into artistic forms. (मूर्तिकार)
 
 
• **Example:** Michelangelo is one of the most famous sculptors in history.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pursuit** (अनुसरण): The act of following or striving to achieve something.

 
 
• **Example:** His pursuit of knowledge led him to explore different cultures around the world.
 
 
 
• **Almighty** (सर्वशक्तिमान): Having complete power; often used to refer to God.
 
 
• **Example:** People of various faiths pray to the Almighty for guidance and blessings.
 
 
 
• **Stampede** (अफरा-तफरी): A sudden, panicked rush of a group of animals or people.
 
 
• **Example:** The sound of a gunshot caused a stampede among the crowd at the event.
